Federated
 Sort: l.id ASC NULLS LAST
  Projection: l.id, l.value, r.label
    Inner Join:  Filter: l.id = r.id
      Filter: l.id BETWEEN Int64(10) AND Int64(20)
        SubqueryAlias: l
          TableScan: orders projection=[id, value]
      SubqueryAlias: r
        TableScan: other_orders projection=[id, label]
